data.narrative:
Bedrock Ocean is a Series A-stage company in the ocean and maritime sector founded by Anthony DiMare and Charles Chiau, having raised $63M to date. The comparable universe consists of two private peers—Seasats and Havoc AI—with no public ocean-tech benchmarks available for direct comparison.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, the only applicable triangulation approach given limited comp data. Using total capital raised ($63M) as a proxy for implied pre-money value, a 2.0x multiplier typical for Series A progression yields a post-money valuation of $126M. This reflects standard step-up expectations between early institutional rounds and subsequent growth capital.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $107M to $145M, centered on $126M. The relatively narrow band reflects confidence in the stage-progression anchor, though meaningful uncertainty persists. The paucity of public comparables and limited private peer data restrict validation of the 2.0x multiplier's appropriateness for this specific subsector. Future iterations would benefit from additional private transaction data or any emerging public ocean-tech valuations to test whether maritime frontier-tech commands materially different growth multiples than broader VC cohorts.
